symbols.name: local-attribute-mirror
symbols.provenance: 1.4b live reads on 2026-11-03: each 0x20-byte entry contains FName +0, serialized byte-array pointer +8, length +0x10, capacity +0x14 and compression flag +0x18. MaxHPTemp is one uncompressed float. Boss_07 native maximum 436870 differs from custom GAS maximum 100000; native SetHP replies clamp absolute HP to that GAS cap. Capture the native maximum before filtering and submit InitialHPPercent = requestedHP/nativeMax once on the next Game update. In PID44456, 0.228901044 yielded first native remaining-HP reply 99637; independent reads showed HP100000 ->99561 and unbalance70 ->69.318 before any break. Other mirror fields remain untouched. Unreadable, compressed or non-positive maxima reject custom birth configuration. No 1.5a IDA addresses are used.

provenance: Native SummonAI registers the original leader identity and summon index but omits the opponent-summoner configuration step. Supplied 1.4b SDK and live disassembly verify camp at character+0xFCC and the 0x34-byte ServerConfigureSummonedAI_HybridMode parameter block (40-byte leader identity, summon index, camp, initial HP fraction). The local attribute mirror must resolve the exact registered ASC through its verified +0x18 object getter. Only custom birth MaxHP/MaxHPTemp are filtered; MaxHPTemp seeds the one-time native HP configuration. Combat authority, HP commits, AI scripts, reporting and all other mirror fields stay native.
unavailable: Reject custom birth requests if any required hook cannot be uniquely resolved.
